title: <tool> busy --json
description: SPEC §4. `running` false means no instance answered (exit 3). Otherwise `busy` and the counts are what /api/busy said (exit 75 if busy, 0 if not). Counts only, until SPEC §10's first question is settled.

counts.description: For each kind of work (the tool's own: chat, job, import, save), how many are under way.

error.description: Something answered, but not with a busy answer (exit 1).
